reason: RALES: 1663 patients with severe HF, EF <=35%, on ACE inhibitor and loop diuretic. Served RR 0.70 (0.60-0.82) printed as relative risk of death. No registry (1999, pre-registration era; documented search found none). Analysis set NOT STATED.
reviewed_note: RALES: 1663 patients with severe HF, EF <=35%, on ACE inhibitor and loop diuretic. Served RR 0.70 (0.60-0.82) printed as relative risk of death. No registry (1999, pre-registration era; documented search found none). Analysis set NOT STATED.

population.span: In a doubleblind study, we enrolled 1663 patients who had severe heart failure and a left ventricular ejection fraction of no more than 35 percent and who were being treated with an angiotensin-converting-enzyme inhibitor, a loop diuretic, and in most cases digoxin.

endpoint.span: The primary end point was death from all causes.

estimate.span: There were 386 deaths in the placebo group (46 percent) and 284 in the spironolactone group (35 percent; relative risk of death, 0.70; 95 percent confidence interval, 0.60 to 0.82; P<0.001).

ci.span: There were 386 deaths in the placebo group (46 percent) and 284 in the spironolactone group (35 percent; relative risk of death, 0.70; 95 percent confidence interval, 0.60 to 0.82; P<0.001).

treatment_strategy.span: A total of 822 patients were randomly assigned to receive 25 mg of spironolactone daily, and 841 to receive placebo.

follow_up.span: The trial was discontinued early, after a mean follow-up period of 24 months, because an interim analysis determined that spironolactone was efficacious.

entry_population_reading.span: In a doubleblind study, we enrolled 1663 patients who had severe heart failure and a left ventricular ejection fraction of no more than 35 percent and who were being treated with an angiotensin-converting-enzyme inhibitor, a loop diuretic, and in most cases digoxin.

analysis_set.absent_reason: Neither held source explicitly states the analysis population used for the mortality estimate; randomised arm sizes do not establish intention-to-treat analysis.

entry_population.extractor_why: The entry population has severe heart failure with ejection fraction no more than 35 percent, matching reduced ejection fraction; adult eligibility and intention-to-treat analysis are not explicitly stated.
